status: No manual labels yet: extraction precision, recall and gap-identification accuracy are NOT measured.

how_to_label.a_statements.csv: Is the predicted type right? If not, give the true type. Check the quote against the arXiv page.
how_to_label.b_datasets.csv: Is the name a dataset or benchmark (not a method, language or organisation)?
how_to_label.c_aspects.csv: Does the paper really concern this aspect, judging from the matched text in context?
how_to_label.d_case_studies.csv: Is each displayed potential gap relevant to the query paper and supported by the evidence shown: supported, plausible, not_supported or unsure?
how_to_label.e_recall_sentences.csv: What is the sentence's true type (or none)? Used to estimate recall.

sampling: hash-ranked with fixed seeds; case-study papers are excluded from their own evidence
